items.text: Observers of the Indian situation tonight could not escape the impression of a decided stiffening of the government’s attitude. Whatever the ominous portent of a superficial quiet which for most of the week pervaded Peshawar, one fact stood out clearly. The British government is fully alive to all events in India and is ready to use arms against any aggression upon its northwest frontier.
